name: Fantastical
soft_passes: #2 scene-fill has no centered glyph to grid; page fills safe zone, balanced but tile-scatter loads bottom-right
#4 tiles blur to dots and gridlines vanish at 16px, but red-band-over-white gestalt survives as 'calendar'
failures: #3 solid-black silhouette collapses to a featureless squircle — named by color+structure, not shape (scene-icon archetype trait)
#6 five saturated hue families vs the <=2 rule — purposeful calendar color-coding, a signature but still a rule break
#7 figure-ground: all four event tiles below the 3:1 floor on white (yellow 1.65, green 1.74, blue 2.52, magenta 2.78:1) — only red band clears at 3.87; separation rescued only by drop-shadow edge
#10 not authored as glass layers; white-ground+multicolor composition would not survive tinted/dark/clear renders (pre-Liquid-Glass)

palette.background: scene: white page #FFFFFF (faintly cool #F9F8FD) + red header ramp #F44B42->#EE2502 with #C05043 under-shadow; ghosted gridlines ~#F5-#F9

light_model: soft top-down: red band highlit at top and shadowed at its lower lip; event tiles carry a gaussian bloom + short soft drop shadow reading as defocused stickers above the page; no specular glass highlight or refraction
layer_stack: white calendar page + ghosted light-gray gridlines
red header band with baked under-shadow
four bloomed multicolor event tiles (green/yellow/blue/magenta) with drop shadows
devices: red header band over white page (wall-calendar skeuomorphic quote, the 16px anchor)
scattered soft-focus multicolor event tiles (multicolor-as-subject, not a single glyph)
ghosted gridlines ~2% darker than white (texture not structure)
rhymes_hint: Apple Calendar (red-header-over-white date-page metaphor) and Photos/App Store (multicolor-as-identity scene icons); style family = full-bleed Big Sur scene icons that spend their personality on color + a metaphor object and deliberately fail the silhouette/palette-economy rules single-glyph tool icons must pass
notes: RESOLUTION CAVEAT: source is a 102x102 web render (upscaled 5x for inspection); no @2x/1024 master. Gridlines, tile-shadow softness and red-band gradient are at the edge of resolvability, so hex values are +/- and the gridline color (~#F5-#F9 on #FFF) is essentially subliminal at native size. MASK: system squircle, full-bleed, art bleeds to all edges. BRAND COHERENCE: red header matches the red 'cal' in the Fantastical logotype and the cover's wordmark. FOR SYNTHESIS: full-bleed multicolor SCENE icon; its #3/#6/#7 failures are the scene-icon archetype (shared with Calendar/Photos), not defects of execution — do not average it against single-glyph tool icons without noting the archetype. The measured sub-3:1 tile contrast is the one honest craft weakness (cheer bought with luminance).
